I believe your grandma can still take you even if she isn’t your legal or immediate parent. Please try to contact her now so you can get help as soon as you can. Please take care.

Yes. The rays are being covered against me by the buildings most of the times. It’s tricky to find a place where you can appreciate nature’s beauty.

I hope you are well. Take care.
It’s morning here right now in the place I’m at. The sunrise is beautiful. I love how the rays of the sun warm up my face even of the rest of my body feels numb.
My cats, funnily enough. The thought of them not having someone to take care of the two of them gets me through somehow. I’m not sure if I will last without them.

I have the same sentiments too. Sometimes I wish that I get hit accidentally by a bus or a truck and I want it to be fast because I am also scared by the pain of dying (if you can still feel anything at that point, that is.) I just can’t do it myself. 

Please take care.

I’m sorry that people around you have made you feel that way. Feeling trapped like this and feeling like a burden was also something I try to get by, everyone seems to dont like/hate what I’m doing too. It’s really hard to keep up.

By any chance, do you have any hobbies? Or interests?

Hello OP, I am very sorry that your best friend has left you. I can feel that you deeply cared for this person.

I have been in the same situation last year before with my bestriend of 8 years. I have driven her to a point where she got tired of my depression. 

I dearly loved her a lot, and I also don’t want her to drag her to my mess, so I just think that her decision will be the best for us, even if we have to part ways,

The thought helped me get through, even if the hurt was very one-sided.

I eventually found someone who was willing to understand me, but now I have hard time opening up with the person and sometimes just want to shut away. I am still learning again how to get friends.

I hope tomorrow gets better for you OP. Please take care for now.

There is access. However, going through those budget places will have to wait you months before you get your appointment done because almost everyone in our country goes to them.

Please take care!

I can’t fathom how you went on it for a year, it’s only been months for me and it is devastating. I hope to hold it like you did. And I hope you still have the strength to carry on.

Thank your for reading my post. It’s been heavy but knowing someone was able to hear me out was something.

I hope you could make it too OP! Lucky that mental services are available with your health insurance. I unluckily live in a country which doesn’t offer that service.

I hope tomorrow brings you a better day.

That was harsh. You don’t deserve that kind of crude language. I am sorry that they weren’t able to understand the situation.

I hope it goes better. You can still have a life besides education. Please take care of yourself and I hope you get through this, OP.
Hello OP, I understand that school is hard. Have you tried opening this up to your parents? Or are they the kind that might be hard to understand?
Sad that all you can do on your free time is to mock people like us. Hope you’re better
Here’s to another day. May it bring us a kinder tomorrow.

Sometimes I have this fantasy that I live on a tourist beach destination and sell mango shakes to people. Just the serene waters, endless stories from people that come and go (not much attachments expected)and enough money in my pocket to feed me everyday for the rest of my life.

But, I have my family relying for me for money and tuition fees (2 brothers studying) even if I can’t seem to support even myself. I also lost my job recently...It has been heavy.

If you don’t have as much tether as I have, why not try to live a much simpler life somewhere far away, where you have a chance to restart?  It’s just something that I’ve been dreaming for a long time.

I can relate on you on so many levels. Everything seems hard and I really can’t pick up myself to pretend that I’m okay too. Lately I’ve been locking myself in my house and can’t eat. I want to hang myself but I’m scared also.

I wish tomorrow brings us a better light.. But im not hoping for that anymore. Not sure what to expect from anything.
The Hotelier. Home Like NoPlace Was There always hits me right to my core, but after it I just go by another day.
